title: Smoky Lentil and Kale Soup
seoTitle: Smoky Lentil and Kale Soup | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Hearty vegetarian pot with fire-roasted tomatoes and smoked paprika
subtitle: Hearty vegetarian pot with fire-roasted tomatoes and smoked paprika
description: Green lentils simmer with onion, carrot, celery, kale, and fire-roasted tomatoes until thick. Smoked paprika adds depth without meat.

steps.title: Sweat aromatics
steps.instruction: Heat olive oil in an 8-quart pot over medium. Cook onion, carrot, and celery 8–10 minutes until softened and onion edges turn translucent.

steps.title: Bloom spices
steps.instruction: Add garlic, smoked paprika, and cumin. Stir 1–2 minutes until spices smell toasty and paste-like, not raw or dusty.

steps.title: Simmer lentils
steps.instruction: Add lentils, tomatoes, broth, and bay leaves. Bring to a boil, reduce to simmer, cook 30–35 minutes until lentils are tender but hold shape.

steps.title: Wilt kale
steps.instruction: Stir in kale and simmer 5 minutes until leaves soften and turn deep green. Soup should be thick enough to coat a spoon lightly.

steps.title: Season and serve
steps.instruction: Remove bay leaves. Adjust salt and pepper. Lentils should be tender with slight bite, not mushy or split open.

proTips: Rinse lentils well—dusty lentils make cloudy, gritty soup.
A parmesan rind simmered in the pot adds umami without meat.
Portion with a 12-oz ladle; crew can add bread for extra calories.
tonightSpread: Crusty whole-grain bread with olive oil.
Shaved parmesan and red pepper flakes.
leftovers: Blend half into a creamy base and return to pot for texture variety.
Freeze flat bags for emergency vegetarian nights.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Budget-friendly and fiber-rich. Gives vegetarian crew a main dish that feels as substantial as meat nights.
mealPrepNotes: Chop mirepoix ahead. Soup thickens overnight—thin with broth when reheating. Station: Use widest pot available so lentils cook evenly without scorching bottom. Station: Stir kale in during last 5 minutes so it stays bright green, not army drab. Station: Offer hot sauce and parmesan at side station for crew who want extra punch.
